name: Break & hold (follow) at the nearest naked busiest prices above / below the open — price only (reference)
why: A first 5-minute close beyond the nearest naked busiest prices above / below the open with aggressive flow behind it is real demand running the stops parked there; the triggered stops add fuel in the same direction. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md). Reference run without the delta condition, 2010-26.

scan.when: !rollwin && ((cl(5,1) > npoca && lag(5, cl(5,1)) <= npoca) || (cl(5,1) < npocb && lag(5, cl(5,1)) >= npocb))
scan.dir: (cl(5,1) > npoca && lag(5, cl(5,1)) <= npoca) - (cl(5,1) < npocb && lag(5, cl(5,1)) >= npocb)
